change_summary: Added a runtime-only monkeypatch runner that retargeted only `breakout_long` signals in Energy or Commodities to 5/6/7 ATR targets across the fixed late_strong, mid_weak, and old_thin snapshots. No production strategy code was changed or promoted.

delta_metrics.decision_basis: No variant improved a majority of non-overlapping windows. Energy 5 ATR was late-only with zero mid/old exposure; Commodities 7 ATR traded off mid improvement against late damage and higher late drawdown.

hypothesis: The post-target audit suggested breakout Energy and breakout Commodities winners may be target-clipped. Widening only those breakout sleeves should improve EV without changing entries, sizing, ranking, LLM, C strategy, or other exits.

llm_metrics.blocker_relation: LLM soft-ranking remains blocked by candidate-level replay coverage; this deterministic exit screen deliberately avoided LLM changes.

market_regime_summary.late_strong: slow-melt bull with Energy and Commodities breakout target exits
market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull with one Commodities breakout target exit and no Energy exposure
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak tape with no qualifying Energy/Commodities breakout target-width exposure

next_retry_requires: Do not retry breakout Energy target widening without a non-overlapping or forward qualifying sample
Do not retry breakout Commodities target widening by only nudging 5-7 ATR values; it already trades off late vs mid
Do not generalize post-target continuation into re-entry or hold-extension without a new discriminator
notes: The runner printed the full screen and wrote the JSON artifact before the shell timeout. This was alpha_search, not measurement repair, and changed one screened causal family in runtime only.
rejection_reason: Rejected on Gate 4 multi-window stability. The post-target continuation signal was real but too sleeve/window-specific to promote into breakout target-width logic.
